metric_definitions.base_rate_brier: Brier score of a constant predictor equal to empirical event frequency on the same scoring population
metric_definitions.log_loss: binary log loss with probability clipping to [1e-15, 1-1e-15] for numerical stability only
metric_definitions.ece: sum over 0.1-wide probability buckets of bucket_count/N * abs(observed_frequency - mean_predicted_probability)
metric_definitions.auc: ROC-AUC via average ranks; N/A when one class is absent
metric_definitions.pr_auc_average_precision: average precision from descending predicted probability ranking
metric_definitions.eligibility: mean_reversion and trend_continuation scored only when Label V2 metadata eligibility is true; ineligible observations are excluded, not counted false

block_bootstrap.method: time-aware contiguous block bootstrap over snapshot order; block size 48 half-hour timestamps (~24h); 200 replicates; descriptive only because horizons overlap

global_baseline_assessment.beats_naive_base_rate_forecasts: mostly no; many event-horizon pairs are worse than base-rate by Brier despite some ranking signal
global_baseline_assessment.range_calibration: ranges are systematically too narrow; actual close coverage is far below 50/70/90 nominal levels
global_baseline_assessment.horizon_insensitivity: event probabilities are identical across horizons for the same snapshot, while outcome frequencies vary materially by horizon
global_baseline_assessment.overlap_caution: main observations are heavily overlapping; non-overlap and block bootstrap are descriptive robustness diagnostics, not iid confidence claims
